name: Large Ensemble Testbed (GOBM simulations)
size_as_stated: 25 ensemble members across four independent GOBMs; 421 monthly time steps from January 1982 to January 2017
access: The dataset used in this work, including the Large Ensemble Testbed, is available from Gloege et al. (2022) [reference 20].

scales.note: 421 monthly time steps (1982-2017) on a 1° x 1° grid across 25 ensemble members from four GOBMs.
